v.rationale: All three pass their suites and use near-identical Filament 4/5 structure: Schemas/Tables classes, enums implementing HasLabel/HasColor, #[Scope] scopes, a policy with delete/deleteAny gated on is_admin, and TestAction-based tests. What separates them is correctness around resolved_at. impl-1's saving observer keeps resolved_at consistent no matter how status changes, and it disables the field in the form. impl-2 and impl-3 only set resolved_at in the Resolve row action and leave it as a free editable field, so resolving through the form records no resolution time and reopening leaves stale data (both probe-confirmed). All three share one gap: non-admins can delete customers, and the cascade deletes their tickets. impl-2 widens that with a customer bulk delete. impl-1 also has the most thorough tests: validation datasets, a resolved_at round-trip, and widget edge cases. impl-3 beats impl-2 on tests (time-frozen assertions, an assertSeeLivewire check, validation datasets) and adds ->authorize('update') on Resolve, but it leaves scaffold residue and a non-absolute diff that can produce negative hours. impl-2 is the leanest but has the weakest tests and the same resolved_at bugs, plus the extra customer bulk delete.
